stories.headline: Zini clashes with Shin Bet officials over need to expand tools used in elections interference case
stories.summary: Shin Bet chief David Zini wants to expand the foreign election interference probe, but three senior officials oppose using additional methods, KAN reports.

stories.headline: U.S. Embassy Warns of Potential 'Mass Casualty Event' in Moscow
stories.summary: Russia's FSB said it had received the report and was "taking appropriate action."

stories.headline: Russia’s Independent Journalism Will Survive in Exile, Gershkovich Says at Inaugural Derk Sauer Lecture
stories.summary: The event was both a tribute to Sauer’s legacy and a discussion of Gershkovich’s work and imprisonment in Russia.

stories.headline: Russia’s Statistics Agency Hit by Cyberattack as Hackers Claim Massive Data Theft
stories.summary: Hackers claimed to have stolen 23 terabytes of data, including information on Russian losses in the war in Ukraine.

stories.headline: Russia's FSB Says Minor Detained Over Moscow Park Attack Threat After U.S. Tip-Off
stories.summary: The U.S. Embassy in Moscow had issued an urgent security alert warning of a credible threat of a mass casualty event.
